<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" font-family="'Segoe UI',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="ndsky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#c9b98d"/>
      <stop offset="0.62" stop-color="#a9986e"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#6e6248"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="ndground" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#8a7a56"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#4a4130"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#ndsky)"/>

  <!-- ash haze -->
  <g fill="#d8cba6" opacity="0.35">
    <ellipse cx="120" cy="150" rx="150" ry="18"/><ellipse cx="480" cy="128" rx="180" ry="14"/>
  </g>

  <!-- flat nothing, a fence, one pole -->
  <rect x="0" y="228" width="640" height="132" fill="url(#ndground)"/>
  <g stroke="#5c5238" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.9">
    <line x1="0" y1="236" x2="640" y2="236"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="248" x2="640" y2="248"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#5c5238">
    <rect x="36" y="206" width="6" height="44"/><rect x="148" y="206" width="6" height="44"/>
    <rect x="262" y="206" width="6" height="44"/><rect x="376" y="206" width="6" height="44"/>
    <rect x="492" y="206" width="6" height="44"/><rect x="602" y="206" width="6" height="44"/>
  </g>

  <!-- the pole-ball pole. bent. -->
  <path d="M556 232 L552 120 Q551 108 562 106" fill="none" stroke="#3f3828" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="560" y1="108" x2="576" y2="158" stroke="#3f3828" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <circle cx="577" cy="164" r="9" fill="#7a3a24" stroke="#2b2418" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- a scooter leaned on nothing -->
  <g transform="translate(96,214)" stroke="#3f3828" stroke-width="3" fill="none">
    <circle cx="0" cy="18" r="13"/><circle cx="46" cy="18" r="13"/>
    <path d="M0 18 L14 2 L34 2 L46 18"/><path d="M14 2 L10 -12 L22 -12"/>
    <rect x="26" y="-8" width="18" height="8" rx="2" fill="#3f3828"/>
  </g>

  <!-- title -->
  <text x="42" y="112" font-size="66" font-weight="700" fill="#2b2418" letter-spacing="2">NORVAL</text>
  <text x="42" y="172" font-size="66" font-weight="700" fill="#2b2418" letter-spacing="2">DYNAMO</text>
  <rect x="46" y="186" width="240" height="4" fill="#7a3a24"/>
  <text x="46" y="308" font-size="13" fill="#2b2418" opacity="0.75" letter-spacing="4">ASHWAY COMMUNITY REEL</text>
  <text x="598" y="308" text-anchor="end" font-size="11" fill="#2b2418" opacity="0.6" letter-spacing="3">RUNS 46 MINUTES</text>
</svg>
name: norval_dynamo_title
